content_patterns: Wizard pattern: thin progress bar + 'STEP N OF 3' label + step-number circle. Question-form heading ('When does your budget reset?') followed by an explanatory paragraph in plain language ('Select the day your income usually arrives. Your spending period will run until the day before this date every month.'). Preset choice tiles ('1st', '15th', 'Last Day') each with a human-readable descriptor, plus an escape-hatch 'Custom' tile with icon implying further input. No visible CTA button in this frame.
notable_interactions: 2-column tile grid of mutually exclusive choices; selected state shown via blue border + light blue fill + icon (Custom), implying a custom date picker opens when chosen. Progress bar implies multi-step onboarding with 3 steps. Back arrow implies previous screen. Absence of a visible Continue button may imply auto-advance on selection or an off-frame CTA.
